longDesc.en: With iOS 14.5+ privacy restrictions, Safari ITP, and browser ad-blockers, standard browser pixels now lose up to 30-40% of conversion data. Server-Side Tracking resolves this by routing event data from your server directly to ad platforms like Meta, Google, and TikTok. Omnix Network deploys GTM Server Containers using Cloudflare and Stape.io to ensure 100% data capture, extended first-party cookie life, and maximum Event Match Quality (EMQ).
